acceptance: Reproduce transaction f031441af607e8bd9631e4b08b34315a417209f9223c515ff8fb40aeb452ee9e: exact accepted candidate 2136f1e1/tree b0bfa846 and immutable incumbent 0bd7cf88 are clean and launch-bound, but promotion stops before baseline, config, signal, launch, or rollback because the external authoritative task-state event log changes while capture_regular_file reads its full 8.23 GB content.

Diagnose the precise contract needed for task_state_store.event_log. It is an external, writable, append-only authoritative journal, not an immutable launch source. Keep the configured absolute path, parent-directory identity, regular-file mode, single-link requirement, device/inode identity, writable checks, outside-command-runtime boundary, and config binding fail closed.

Implement a bounded descriptor-based journal capture and revalidation that permits only proven append growth during capture. It must reject truncation, prefix/content rewrite, same-size mutation, truncate-and-regrow, inode or path replacement, symlink or hard-link substitution, parent-component drift, permission drift, non-regular files, and movement inside the command runtime before TERM.

Do not weaken OSLaunchFilesystem.capture_regular_file for supervisor.py, ai-status.sh, ai_status.py, the interpreter, config, or any other immutable launch source. The append-only behavior must be explicit and limited to task_state_event_log, with a summary/revalidation identity sufficient to prove the same journal is still bound at the transaction boundary.

Add focused adversarial tests for concurrent append acceptance, multi-append growth, stable empty and large journals, prefix overwrite, same-size rewrite, truncation/regrowth, inode/path/parent swap, symlink/hard-link, mode/link-count drift, unwritable journal/parent, and event-log placement inside the candidate. Prove every invalid case aborts before config mutation or process signalling.

Run the complete promotion suite and any directly affected task-state/status tests. Commit a task-scoped evidence manifest before independent review and bind the exact reviewed head through the normal task PR into dev.

Preserve immutable candidate cleanliness, config CAS, promotion-lock ordering, restart-intent-before-TERM, process-generation and admission-lock checks, worker-lease parity, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and python -B launch, status-child bytecode proof, three fresh-loop gates, authoritative-shadow catch-up, provider baseline, and rollback identity/cleanup.

Keep this task source-only: no live config/state edit, direct process signal, worker termination, runtime promotion, candidate/incumbent mutation or deletion, canonical-state edit outside governed commands, scheduler/fleet-routing policy change, provider/account change, or rollout retry. A retry requires a separately dispatched task after protected source merge.
task_spec.phase: Supervisor Runtime / Source-only Append-only Journal Capture
task_spec.summary: The governed 2136f1e1 retry remained fail-closed because immutable-file capture reads the live 8.23 GB append-only task-state journal and rejects legitimate concurrent append growth. Add a narrowly typed, descriptor-bound journal capture that allows only proven appends while retaining every path, inode, prefix, permission, transaction, and runtime safety gate; leave rollout to a later dispatch.
task_spec.title: Capture the live task-state journal coherently for promotion
